title: Capsule Tambour Door Compatibility
description: Fix door vortex compatibilities: door capsule east only with door tambour west; door capsule west only with door tambour east; not cross-compatible on same side.
summary: Removed east/west complement mirroring. Door capsule vortex side is inferred from connector local CAD X (x<0 → west, x≥0 → east) even when the kit port id says east. enrichKindCatalogBundleDoorCapsules relabels palette kinds without adding a second vortex. Relabeled 113 vortices in nakagin-capsule-tower.3d.json (catalog + scene). Puzzle 3d react tests: 250 passed.
